url.title: Directus URL
url.description: Base URL of the Directus instance, e.g. https://has-ai.directus.app

token.title: Static Token or Access Token
token.description: Directus admin/static token used to write items. Prefer a static token.

email.title: Email (optional)
email.description: If no static token is provided, email+password login is used to obtain a temporary access token.

password.title: Password (optional)
password.description: Password for email login when token is empty.

collection_map.title: Stream to Collection map
collection_map.description: Map Airbyte stream names to Directus collection names. Defaults cover Beeper streams.

primary_key_map.title: Stream to upsert key
primary_key_map.description: Field used to upsert/dedupe each stream into Directus.

batch_size.title: Batch size
batch_size.description: How many records to buffer before flushing to Directus.
